title: fix(plugin-auth): keep a configured http://localhost base URL as written
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi99DPJE9mWdrQwcutNhUtpH8)_
Fixes #31904

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：显式配置的认证基础地址(`OS_AUTH_URL`、`OS_BASE_URL` 或插件的 `baseUrl`)现在原样保留，即使它是 `http://localhost`;只有什么都没配置时，开发服务器才把端口改成实际监听的端口。
- 为什么改：放在代理后面(`OS_AUTH_URL=http://localhost`,应用监听 :3000)时，邀请链接、邀请邮件和邮件里的登录/重置链接被改写成 `http://localhost:3000`,指向一个没有对外发布的端口。
- 风险与回滚：只影响「显式配置了 localhost 地址、但服务器端口不同」这一种组合，它以前被改写，现在按配置走;没配置的开发场景不变，受信来源(trusted origins)解析不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-plugin.ts` 的 `kernel:ready` 端口修正(`baseUrlConfigured`);`packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` 里传给 AuthPlugin 的 `baseUrlDefaulted`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/auth-plugin.test.ts`,应见 116 个用例全绿，末尾 4 个是新加的基础地址用例。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-plugin.ts`: the `kernel:ready` port auto-correction (which calls `authManager.setRuntimeBaseUrl('http://localhost:BOUND_PORT')`) now runs only when no base URL was configured: no `baseUrl` option, or one marked `baseUrlDefaulted`. A configured `baseUrl` is the deployment's public origin and is kept as written, `http://localhost` included. The existing guard that never rewrites a non-localhost origin is unchanged.

New option `AuthPluginOptions.baseUrlDefaulted?: boolean` (default `false`): the host says its `baseUrl` is its own loopback fallback, not a configured value. This carries the "explicit" bit from where the default is applied, because `os serve` always hands the plugin a value (`resolveAuthBaseUrl`: `OS_AUTH_URL` → `BETTER_AUTH_URL` → `OS_BASE_URL` → `http://localhost:PORT`), so the plugin alone cannot tell `OS_AUTH_URL=http://localhost` from the fallback.

`packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts`: passes `baseUrlDefaulted: baseUrlResolution.source === null`. `source` is the resolver's existing report of which variable supplied the value (`null` = none of the three, the fallback). No env is re-read anywhere.

Unchanged: trusted-origins resolution (`serve` still adds the configured origin from the same `baseUrlResolution`; sign-in reads it as before), `resolveAuthBaseUrl` itself, `plugin-dev` (passes its `authBaseUrl` option or nothing) and the verify harness (passes no `baseUrl`, so it is still corrected).

## Tests

New top-level `describe` at the end of `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-plugin.test.ts`, booting the plugin through `kernel:ready` against a server whose `getPort()` answers the bound port, and reading the Console URLs the auth mail uses (`AuthManager.getConsoleUrl`, the same composer as the invitation link):

- configured `http://localhost`, bound 3000: `setRuntimeBaseUrl` never called; invite link `http://localhost/_console/accept-invitation/inv_1`, sign-in `http://localhost/_console/login` (no `:3000`). RED on main.
- configured `http://localhost:4000`, bound 3000: stays `:4000`. RED on main.
- CONTROL: host-defaulted `http://localhost:0` (`baseUrlDefaulted: true`), bound 41303: corrected to `http://localhost:41303`.
- CONTROL: no `baseUrl`, bound 3002: corrected to `http://localhost:3002`.

Forced test edit: `Start Phase › should auto-detect baseUrl from http-server port when port differs` pinned the old behaviour (an explicit `baseUrl: 'http://localhost:3000'` rewritten to `:3002`). It now boots a host-defaulted base URL (`baseUrlDefaulted: true`) and asserts the same correction, renamed `…when the host-defaulted port differs`.

<details><summary>Red on main (before the fix, 489f0cea)</summary>

```
× keeps a configured http://localhost as written: the invite link carries no bound port
× keeps a configured http://localhost:4000 on a server bound to 3000
AssertionError: expected "setRuntimeBaseUrl" to not be called at all, but actually been called 1 times
  1st setRuntimeBaseUrl call: "http://localhost:3000"   (both cases)
Tests  2 failed | 2 passed
```
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs; the test imports src, no dist leg)</summary>

Mutation: drop the configured check, `if (!baseUrlConfigured && this.authManager` → `if (this.authManager`. `ok mutation landed: anchor 1 -> 0`. Red: both configured-origin pins (`2 failed | 114 passed`), the two CONTROL pins stay green. Restored: `ok restored: blob == HEAD (00d25f5d0adc) and git diff HEAD is empty`.
</details>

<details><summary>Live boot (card item 1): examples/app-todo, `objectstack dev --fresh -p 38917`, OS_LOG_LEVEL=info</summary>

| Configured | main 489f0cea | this branch |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `OS_AUTH_URL=http://localhost` | `Auth baseUrl auto-updated to http://localhost:38917 (configured: http://localhost)` | no rewrite; origin stays `http://localhost` |
| `OS_BASE_URL=http://localhost` | same rewrite to `:38917` | no rewrite |
| nothing | fallback is `http://localhost:38917` (serve resolves the port before boot), equal to the bound port, no rewrite | same |

The `baseUrl` option case is the plugin-level pin above (serve passes the env value through that option).
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- New public name: the option key `baseUrlDefaulted` on `AuthPluginOptions` (listed for the seat's ruling).
- Observed, not changed (pre-existing, same on main): with `objectstack dev -p 0`, `kernel:ready` fires before the transport has listened, so `getPort()` still answers `0` and the correction is skipped; the auth origin stays `http://localhost:0` while the server binds an ephemeral port. Reported to the seat.

## Verification

Head `34ff9fae68` (merged origin/main at `cfac93a8`; the last commit after that merge only types the new test helper). `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth test`: Test Files 250 passed, Tests 4507 passed | 10 skipped. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck`: exit 0. eslint on the three touched source files: exit 0.
